_about: KPC site-check recipes: one per tool, as data. Steps run in order; {ref} is replaced by the park's ref. Step kinds: fill, type, press, click, click_text (sel + exact text), wait_for, wait_outline (until a new outline shape is drawn or status_sel shows a label), sleep, goto. 'optional': true lets the next step run if this one fails. read.card = the card the visitor reads; read.status / read.label = where the label is (the label is read from label, else status, else card); read.fit = the box that must fit the phone screen. notice = the page's information notice (selector, or text). ignore_panes = Leaflet panes whose shapes are not 'the outline' (the trail layer). Chat 10 owns this file: change selectors here, not in the code. only_prefixes / skip_prefixes: which refs a recipe is used for. click: clicks the first VISIBLE match; settle_ms waits before the click (the map pans to the card). reclick N: if the clicked button neither changes nor goes away within 2.5 s, click again (up to N more times). if_dead: steps to run when a clicked button stays dead (the dead button is still reported).

us_planner._note: Oct 31 2026: after 'click the first suggestion' the card is already open; clicking the park's row re-draws the open card and its buttons lose their click handlers, so SHOW THIS PARK'S OUTLINE does nothing. The robot reports that as 'a button did nothing' and then closes the card and clicks the row again (if_dead) to finish the check.
